_comment: Closed vocabularies for the tag namespaces. This file is the single
source of truth: both the JSON schema (enum constraints) and the
vocabulary section of the prompt are generated from it. Edit only here,
min/max control how many values are allowed per field. min 0 means the
model is allowed to stay silent when there is nothing notable.
subject has no vocabulary - the model generates it freely.

category.hint: The single category that best classifies this photograph.

color.hint: Colours that stand out, not necessarily the ones covering most area. Leave empty for purely black and white images; a monochrome toned image keeps its hue.

tone.hint: Tonal character of the finished image as a whole. monochrome means toned in a single hue; black and white means no colour at all.

light.hint: The lighting situation of the scene.

composition.hint: Only when the compositional structure is clearly recognisable. Leave empty otherwise.

technique.hint: Only what the exposure itself produced mechanically.

mood.hint: Only when the mood is unmistakable.

subject.hint: Free vocabulary: what is visible in the photograph.
